name: honest_error_out_of_range
description: Honest-error behaviour: an impossible request must return an 'error' key, not a silent ok. NOTE: the brief specified add_slur as a 'blocked' tool, but add_slur is in fact implemented (ScoreAccess.addSlur / Dispatch.js) and returns ok, so it does NOT exercise honest-error handling. Substituted a deterministic error case: querying a measure that does not exist. getKeyAt returns {error:'Measure N not found'} when the tick is out of range (ScoreAccess.js getKeyAt).

steps.prompt: What key signature is in effect at measure 999? Use the get_key_at tool to check.
